title: Positive profinite Cech exactness for norm-topological algebraic scalars
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended nonarchimedean norm topology. Work in the compatible profinite universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A profinite set means a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space. Let $q:T\to V$ be a continuous surjection of profinite sets. For $n\geq0$ put
$$T_V^{n+1}=\{(t_0,\ldots,t_n)\in T^{n+1}:q(t_0)=\cdots=q(t_n)\},$$
with its subspace topology, and put $C^n=C(T_V^{n+1},\Omega)$, the additive group of all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Define
$$ (d^nf)(t_0,\ldots,t_{n+1})=\sum_{j=0}^{n+1}(-1)^j f(t_0,\ldots,\widehat{t_j},\ldots,t_{n+1}). $$
For every $n\geq1$ and every $f\in C^n$ satisfying $d^nf=0$, there exists $g\in C^{n-1}$ with $d^{n-1}g=f$. This is equality in additive groups, without closure of images. The empty surjection is included. The coefficient field is the noncomplete norm field $\Omega$ itself; neither completion nor restriction to functions valued in one finite subextension is made.
